description: Send any ERC-20 token from the Agent Wallet to a recipient. Resolves the token address and decimals from the global registry, then calls agentTransferToken through the AgentAccountV2 contract. Subject to configured spend limits. Identical retries replay the original tx; pass idempotencyKey to distinguish two equal invoices. An RPC drop after broadcast fail-closes instead of sending a second transfer.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key (1-128 non-whitespace chars). Distinct keys allow two equal payments.

name: send_token
